newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia T-bond sale seen possible this week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia T-bond sale seen possible this week.

text.p: An Australian Treasury bond tender is seen possible this week, even though the state of Victoria is closed for holiday for the initial announcement of any offering today, traders said.
"It's a distinct possibility. It will probably be the usual format of a short and a long dated stock," said one trader at a European based bank.
The last tender was held on February 11 when a total of A$900 million was offered, a large proportion of which was in the current 10-year benchmark November 2006 bond.
This time round, traders saw the Treasury moving further along the curve for the longer maturity and tapping the October 2007 stock.
Details of the tender would be announced at 12.00 p.m. (0100 GMT) and final bids would be due in at 12.45 p.m. (0145 GMT) on Tuesday.
